notes:
- Version numbers and automatic updates: OpenDimensions now knows its version, checks for a new one a few seconds after Illustrator starts and offers to install it (it finishes when you quit Illustrator). Help > Check for OpenDimensions Updates... checks on request.
- Per-layer scales that read and write HotDoor CADtools layer scales, and dimensions that follow the scale when it changes.
- Corner radius tool, and Universal, Aligned and Auto dimension tools.
- Mac build and Mac settings panel.
